title: SPGR Run Brief v1
description: A compact per-run projection at runs/<run-id>/run-brief.json: the profile that scales the lifecycle, the run flags, the pinned human rulings as one line each, and the operative artifact list with versions. The harness refreshes it at Act whenever a ruling lands or an artifact is versioned, and rehydration reads it instead of the artifact corpus. Derived and regenerable, never the source of truth. Held to a few thousand tokens.

profile.description: Scales the phase set, the story and criteria caps, and the PR unit. See the run-profiles table in .claude/references/pdca-harness.md.

phase_set.description: The phases this profile routes, in order. A unit outside this set is held.

autonomy.description: Which gates pause the run and which decisions are taken by default and reviewed in a batch. Defaults to standard on brochure and small and supervised on saas and mobile. autopilot is allowed on brochure and small only. See Autonomy levels in .claude/references/pdca-harness.md.

size.description: Honored on mobile only. small keeps the store lifecycle and the App Store vertical at the small profile's ceremony: at most 25 stories, ADRs only for regrettable decisions, statement plus check criteria, one PR per batch. Ignored on every other profile.

auto_merge_on_green.description: brochure and small only. Code Reviewer APPROVE plus fully green required checks merges the PR without a human pause. A human decision recorded in the project CLAUDE.md. Implied true under autonomy autopilot.

docs_render.description: When docs/ is rendered. Never on every artifact edit.

pinned_rulings.description: One line per human ruling: id, the ruling in the human's words, the artifacts it changes.

operative_artifacts.description: Name to repo-relative path plus version of each artifact that currently governs the run.

pr_unit.description: What one pull request and one pr-merge gate cover under this profile.
